summary: Independently verified all eight acceptance criteria against the live candidate. Repository checks passed. No technical findings.

Executed node --input-type=module assertions comparing WORKFLOW_EVENTS and Object.keys(WORKFLOW_TRANSITIONS) with the ten specified events. Both matched exactly.

Executed node --input-type=module assertions inspecting BuilderHandoffSchema, BuilderHandoffSubmissionSchema, and the registered maestro_record_builder_handoff parameters. Each exposed exactly done and escalation. Inspected BuilderRunResult in src/tools/main/run-builder.ts and confirmed its two corresponding variants; typecheck passed.

Ran npm run check after inspecting extensions/maestro.integration.test.ts. Its saved technical-problem escalation scenario submitted the unavailable-compiler fixture, completed delegation normally, and asserted the returned escalation-decision phase, escalation outcome, and reported problem handoff. Passed.

Ran npm run check after inspecting src/workflow/builder/completeBuilderPass.integration.test.ts. Mixed passed/failed/not-run statuses survived reopening the saved escalation. The separate all-passed technical escalation was accepted and retained its supplied results. Passed.

Ran npm run check: completeBuilderPass.integration.test.ts resolved B1/E1 with Retry the required check, prepared another pass, created a fresh Pi child session, and saved a passed done handoff as B2.json. Assertions confirmed the spec remained unchanged and B1 retained its resolution.

Ran npm run check: extensions/maestro.integration.test.ts saved a technical escalation, revised the same temporary spec to use a local check, invoked the registered approval tool, and confirmed saved ready-for-builder state with the unchanged spec ID.

Ran npm run check: src/tools/main/run-builder.integration.test.ts submitted done with AC1 passed and escalations [], completed delegation normally, and asserted the parent result equaled outcome done, phase ready-for-verifier, and the reopened active handoff.

notes: npm run lint and non-fixing oxlint passed before npm run check. The full check passed 203 tests across 37 files, typecheck, lint, and coverage thresholds.
Integration probes used isolated offline Pi sessions with scripted delegation responses, not live model calls.

Inspected execution/protocol error handling and current instructions, status mappings, and documentation. No obsolete failure-outcome references were found in current source, tests, instructions, or workflow documentation.

No pre-existing file contents changed during checks. Removed generated coverage files and the temporary original-content backup before submission. Historical artifacts and the approved spec remained unchanged.
